anomalies.observed: C8 is a 1nF/25V capacitor on the EPD booster network (C8.1 to J1.5). The spec lists the C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 group as 1 µF/25 V, matching the PDI default. The netlist's C8 value is 1000× smaller than the other members of that group (C5, C7, C9, C10 are all 1uF/25V). The SPICE deck also models it as 1nF.
anomalies.expected: C8 should be 1 µF/25 V like the other EPD default capacitors in this group, as stated in the spec.
anomalies.impact: A 1nF capacitor instead of 1µF on the panel supply/booster node gives far too little filtering and charge reservoir, which can cause ripple and unstable panel drive or failed refresh.

anomalies.observed: C1 is 0.1uF/16V on the Display_Power_Switch rail. The spec says the EPD G1-group reference value for this position is 1 µF/6.3 V, and it lists C1 among the 1 µF/25 V group. Neither matches 0.1 µF/16 V.
anomalies.expected: C1 should be 1 µF with a voltage rating that suits the panel rail, per the spec's stated values.
anomalies.impact: Reduced bulk capacitance on the display power rail weakens decoupling and boost-output filtering, which can affect panel stability during refresh.

anomalies.observed: C11 is a 0.1uF capacitor assigned an inductor land pattern (Inductor_SMD:L_0805_2012Metric_Pad1.05x1.20mm_HandSolder). Its pin 1 is on a net of its own, unconnected, and only pin 2 reaches GND.
anomalies.expected: A 0.1 µF capacitor should carry a capacitor footprint and be connected across the supply it decouples. The spec does not mention C11.
anomalies.impact: C11 provides no decoupling because one terminal is floating. The wrong footprint may also be a sourcing or assembly error, and the part may not fit a capacitor pad pattern correctly.
